units.source_text: “啊，我一下将棋，就想唱歌，太失礼了。

en.t: Ah, whenever I play shogi, I feel like singing. How terribly rude of me.

units.source_text: 实际上，我是喜欢将棋的，不知为什么没去搞将棋而下围棋了。

en.t: The truth is, I like shogi, but for some reason I ended up playing go instead of pursuing shogi.

units.source_text: 这个问题，我反复思考，至今仍百思不得其解。

en.t: I have thought about this again and again, and even now I still cannot make sense of it.

units.source_text: 我下将棋的时间远比围棋长久。

en.t: I have spent far longer playing shogi than playing go.

units.source_text: 记得我四岁上就学会了将棋，为什么学会了那么长时间，反倒不强呢……”

en.t: I remember learning shogi when I was only four, so why, after knowing it for so long, am I not strong at it after all?
